answer_2.quote: We report the grounding accuracy defined as the average number of correct predictions (i.e., IoU greater than 0.50).

answer_4.quote: We manually evaluate 101 samples due to annotation complexity. Human direction accuracy is measured by the angle between the forward direction and the ground truth (from annotated human positions to top-view centers), considering it accurate if within ±30 degrees.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate correctness of object positions and human directions in generated top-view representations.
